title: All About Grasshoppers
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about grasshoppers.

pages.brief: Nell the bee hovering just above a bright green grasshopper perched on a blade of long grass.
A close-up of the grasshopper, its long, bent back legs clearly visible.
The grasshopper mid-jump, leaping a great distance across the grass.
A close-up of the grasshopper’s head, showing two long thin feelers.
The grasshopper rubbing its back legs together, a sound coming from the motion.
Nell the bee pausing in the air, listening intently to the grasshopper’s song.
The grasshopper blending in almost perfectly with the green blades of grass around it.
Nell the bee looking closely, the grasshopper nearly invisible against the grass.
The grasshopper leaping away in a big jump, disappearing into the tall grass.
Nell the bee smiling, watching the spot where the grasshopper vanished into the grass.
